item.title: Lawyers in the Library: Employment & Civil Law — Thu Nov 5, 12:00 PM — Central Santa Rosa Library
item.description: Local volunteer attorneys offer free legal information and referral for matters of civil and employment law only. These lawyer consultations will last up to 20 minutes. Sign-ups are first come, first served in person and begin at 11:30 am. \(30 minutes before the program begins\) The attorneys are volunteers and provide only legal information. They do not provide specific legal advice and should not be considered as personal lawyers for any reason. You will be required to sign a waiver before speaking to an attorney that states that no attorney-client relationship is being created with this free service. Spanish language consultations are available via translator. Participants may bring support persons, family members or other affiliated persons to meet with the attorney together. For deaf and hard of hearing participants, the Sonoma County Bar Association will make arrangements for ASL interpretation with at least two days' advance notice. Please contact Reception@SonomaCountyBar.org

item.description:
Bay Area hip-hop artists Footz The Beast, Mistah F.A.B., J Stalin, Compton AV, and many others will come together in Vallejo for the “Bring Chantel Home” Benefit Concert.
Chantel “CiCi” Brooks has been missing since July 17, 2026, after last being seen in Fairfield. The purpose of the concert is to keep her story in the public eye, encourage anyone with information to come forward, and raise funds for her family’s continued search, including investigative assistance, search expenses, and public-awareness efforts.
Chantel is 5’6”, approximately 140 pounds, with black hair, brown eyes, a nose piercing, and multiple tattoos. If you have any information regarding her disappearance, please contact:🚨 FAIRFIELD POLICE DEPARTMENT📞 707-428-7300, CASE \#26-100539
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
Join us for a relaxed and social paint & sip evening. You'll be guided step-by-step through painting a scenic view using acrylics, with plenty of room to make it your own.
Whether you follow along or add your own creative twist, the focus is on enjoying the process and having fun. Sip on a beverage, come with friends or meet new ones, and settle into a laid-back night of painting and connection. No experience needed - just show up and create.
Genevieve Elkin was Born and raised in Mill Valley, California and is a multidisciplinary artist now based in Petaluma. item.title: Write & Collage: Words, Images & Memory — Sat Nov 14, 10:00 AM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Join Marlene Cullen for a creative two-hour experience that brings writing and collage together. In the first hour, guided freewriting prompts invite you to explore memorable moments, stories, and experiences in a welcoming, supportive environment. In the second hour, transform those reflections into a visual expression using images, colors, and textures.
No writing or art experience is necessary—just bring your curiosity and a willingness to explore.
Bring: A notebook and pen. Collage materials will be provided, and you're welcome to bring a favorite poem, magazines, photographs, or other materials you'd like to incorporate.
Marlene Cullen is the founder of Writers Forum and creator of Jumpstart Writing Workshops. Through her website and blog, The Write Spot, she shares resources and inspiration to help writers discover and develop their voices.
The Write Spot anthologies edited by Marlene are collections of short stories, poems, and vignettes with prompts to encourage writing.
